subject: [hw] DONE T02: fake n2vc_hw, H.264/HEVC/JPEG validators, phone test scripts
body:
DONE T02 (host-only; no phone access, nothing published).

Last lines of the two acceptance commands:
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6158/6158
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22

hw: three builds (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan), each 6158 checks, ~2 s, under /tmp/n2hw-T02/hw. Covers all 12 windows and power blocks, -EACCES + violation count for unpowered access, power refcounts/implications, exact recorder lines, masked writes, POLL success/timeout, DELAY bound, IRQ fire/timeout/clear/status, a threaded wait_irq, DMA first-fit/overlap/reuse/zero-fill, script set/read/once/env, parse errors keep old rules, bounded self-trigger chain.
check: 22 checks; good H.264/HEVC from installed libx264/libx265, good JPEG from ffmpeg and cjpeg; truncated, wrong-size, wrong-frame-count, all-black and 4:4:4-by-default streams/pictures must fail; gen_yuv deterministic/size/motion/static==hwc.py; I420 source mode. Pure Python, no numpy; ffmpeg/ffprobe/djpeg as oracles.

Implemented (owned files only):
  tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c, n2vc_hw_fake.h, t_fake.c, run_tests.sh, README.md, scripts/*.txt
  tests/check/{n2vcheck.py,h264_check.py,hevc_check.py,jpeg_check.py,gen_yuv.py,run_tests.sh,README.md}
  tests/phone/{rwvc_probe.c,guest-n2hw-tests.sh,run_phone_tests.sh,README.md,00-preflight.md,10-jpeg.md,20-vcodec-readonly.md,30-venc-power.md,40-daemon-encode.md,50-recovery.md}
  dsh-state/workers/T02/STATUS.md

Not done / open (also in STATUS):
1. 40-daemon-encode.md is a template: hw-ip/hw-p03 have not confirmed binary names, CLI and stdout format; the guest runner has the stage but ENABLE_DAEMON=0 by default and SKIPs without the binaries.
2. The 0296 autotest kernel in this tree has no exec command, so run_phone_tests.sh requires $PHONE_EXEC (ssh/serial/guest exec) and exits 2 rather than guessing. Guest runner itself is complete.
3. rwvc_probe.c is host compile-checked only; the main session/hw-ip must link it for iOS.
4. No phone run, no real /dev/redwood-* ioctl; all claims are host-tested/compiled only.
5. Fake limits: regs() has no per-batch poll timeout (global default 100 ms, settable); wait_irq really sleeps; script load not concurrent; DMA has no multi-file ownership.
No review findings yet. I stay on the board for hw-r1/hw-r2 and integrator requests.
